label: Root
summary: Minimum shared contract for Tiinex lineage artifacts; abstract envelope and fallback.
root.parent.absent: No parent edge declared; artifact is local lineage root unless another relation says otherwise.
root.parent.schema.missing: Parent edge is present but Parent Schema is missing.
root.parent.trace.missing: Parent edge is present but Trace is missing; lineage traversal will be degraded.
root.parent.origin.missing: Parent edge is present but Origin is missing; recovery will rely on other hints.
root.repairs.declared: Envelope declares repair notes; validators should preserve unknown repair fields.
root.envelope.readable: Root envelope is readable at current validation depth.
root.fallback.used: Schema module is unavailable; root/envelope semantics only.
integrity.validation.skipped: Continuity Integrity footer is missing; integrity engine did not run byte/canonicalization validation.
integrity.method.unspecified: Continuity Integrity exists but no machine-verifiable integrity method is declared.
integrity.c14n-v2.detected: c14n-v2 integrity method is declared; the integrity engine evaluates self entries when canonical artifact bytes are available.
integrity.local-draft.declared: Draft/local integrity marker is present; it is a recoverability marker, not a published byte-verification proof.
integrity.c14n-v2.verified: c14n-v2 self-integrity is verified against the current canonical artifact bytes.
integrity.c14n-v2.mismatch: c14n-v2 self-integrity does not match the current canonical artifact bytes.
integrity.c14n-v2.ambiguous: c14n-v2 self-integrity could not be verified unambiguously.
